description.value: You built vessels that went where land ended. The work was large-scale and collaborative, requiring you to manage other people's labor while keeping the structural logic of the whole thing in your head simultaneously.

system.startingEquipment:
Common clothes
work gloves
work boots
system.features: Harbor Standing: Every vessel you built or repaired is evidence of your skill, visible in ports where it still sails. Harbor masters, ship owners, and maritime merchants know a skilled shipwright when they see one. In any working port your expertise opens access to shipyards, dry docks, and the offices of those who commission vessels, and your assessment of a ship's condition carries weight in any maritime negotiation.
